URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/global-stocks-erase-losses-oil-tumbles-after-trump-says-us-will-end-4-billion-funding-to-israel/
(Times of Israel liveblog, Reuters and ToI staff, 3 Nov 2026 5:35pm Israel time)
European and U.S. stock markets reversed earlier losses, with the pan-European STOXX 600 index rising 0.13% to 650.3 points and S&P 500 futures gaining 0.14%. Oil prices declined following the comments.
